## Change and reason

Describe what broke or is intentionally changing.

## Validation

Include local test results and, where relevant, actual Intel Sequoia build/pour
logs. Distinguish fixture tests, syntax checks and native results.

## Review

Confirm scope, recipe/engine/action commits, dependency drift, license/source
obligations, credential boundaries and absence of destructive client commands.
Do not include the user's audit archive, Brewfile, credentials or private paths.
